input_messages.content: Hi! I recently bought a digital camera from your store, but it doesn’t zoom in as much as I was hoping. I use it mainly for bird-watching, so I really need something with the highest possible zoom. I’d like to exchange it for a model with the maximum zoom you have, but I want all the other features to stay the same. Can you help me with this? I’d also like to get this sorted out as quickly as possible.
I actually don’t remember the email I used for the purchase, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. Let me know if you need any other details to look up my order!
I don’t have the order number handy, but I placed the order about two weeks ago. Would that help you find it? Let me know if you need any more information from me.

Thanks for the details! Yes, I want to exchange my current camera for the 30MP model with 10x zoom and SD card storage, and that’s the only item I want to exchange from this order.

However, I’d like to use my PayPal account to pay the price difference instead of the cards you mentioned. Is that possible? If so, please proceed with PayPal. I’d really appreciate it if we could get this done as quickly as possible!
Yes, that’s all correct! Please go ahead and process the exchange and use my PayPal account for the payment. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Thank you so much for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the email with the return instructions. That’s all I needed for now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
